title: Flasque modules have vanishing higher Cech cohomology for every open covering
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a ringed space, a flasque sheaf of modules F and an open covering, the lemma shows that all higher Cech cohomology groups of the covering vanish (statement lines 1963-1970). The proof applies the Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence: the presheaves of higher cohomology appearing in its low degree terms vanish because F is flasque and hence acyclic for the global section functors, and the spectral sequence then degenerates to give both the equality of Cech and ordinary cohomology and the vanishing (proof lines 1972-1977). The chapter text immediately before the lemma warns that the statement fails for flasque presheaves, which is why the sheaf hypothesis is essential. The claim is H2: one spectral sequence applied with a vanishing input, with the two steps (vanishing of the presheaves, then degeneration) explicitly named.
